Author: aki
Name: KittyUI Companion
Punchline: KittyUI inside the game: a live layout studio, plugin settings, themes, profiles, backups, macros and a plugin browser.
Description: The in-game half of KittyUI. Move and resize the plugins' elements and the game's own HUD over the real HUD, edit every plugin's settings in one place, recolour them with one palette, install UI themes, switch and save kitty collections, write macros, browse and update plugins by reading their repositories directly, and keep backups. Changes reach the plugins without a restart; the desktop app shares the same data. Does nothing on its own: KittyUI asks, the companion does, never in combat.
Changelog:
- Kitty framework 1.4.4.0
- settings no longer jump back after an edit
- a setting shows as changed only when it differs
- Naowh theme: HUD panels black at 70%
